name: canvas-study
description: Study from your own Canvas courses with spaced review, retrieval practice, and deadline planning. Read-only: it cannot submit or change anything in Canvas.

canvas_url.title: Canvas URL
canvas_url.description: Your school's Canvas address, such as canvas.illinois.edu

canvas_token.title: Canvas Access Token
canvas_token.description: In Canvas, open Account > Settings, choose New Access Token, and paste the token here. It stays on this computer.
